exploit_name: Stale redemption liabilities lead to leveraged losses for remaining shareholders
description: Once redemption is fulfilled, share-to-asset conversion locks at that moment's price. If vault performance deteriorates afterward, remaining shareholders absorb disproportionate losses.
root_cause: Once redemption is fulfilled, share-to-asset conversion locks at that moment's price. If vault performance deteriorates afterward, remaining shareholders absorb disproportionate losses.
fix_description: Implement mark-to-market redemption pricing or time-decay on fulfilled redemptions.
notes: Remaining shareholders suffer leveraged losses while fulfilled redeemers are protected.
